{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check unique values in channel and converted columns
channel_unique = df['channel'].unique()
converted_unique = df['converted'].unique()

# Check data types
dtypes = df.dtypes

print("Missing values:\n", missing_values)
print("\nUnique values in channel:", channel_unique)
print("\nUnique values in converted:", converted_unique)
print("\nData types:\n", dtypes)"}
